tools.name: lookup_company
tools.description: Look up a company by legal name, or check an EU VAT id. When tax_id is set, VIES is the only source and the row has vies_valid true or false. error vies_unavailable means VIES did not answer and the call is not charged. error bad_tax_id means the number is not an EU VAT id and the call is not charge

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "lookup_company" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Look up a company by legal name or registration number, and check an EU VAT id when tax_id is set. Returns credits_remaining plus companies with name, country, company_number, lei, tax_id, status, address, source, and confidence. Costs 0.05 credit on success. A missing API key is not charged. An emp" → after: "Look up a company by legal name, or check an EU VAT id. When tax_id is set, VIES is the only source and the row has vies_valid true or false. error vies_unavailable means VIES did not answer and the call is not charged. error bad_tax_id means the number is not an EU VAT id and the call is not charge"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
